normative_extracts.quote: Only the modified path from root to leaf is cloned; unchanged sibling subtrees retain their exact object references across history snapshots.
structuredClone() creates a deep clone of a given value, allocating new memory for every nested object and array.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Stores undo/redo history by cloning only the modified ancestor spine in O(depth) while sharing untouched subtrees by reference, enabling O(1) === equality checks.

production_failures.symptom: Browser tab hits Out-Of-Memory (OOM) crash after 40 undoable edits on a 5MB document
production_failures.root_cause: Undo stack pushed full structuredClone() or JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state)) snapshots on every keystroke.
production_failures.mitigation: Use structural sharing (path copying / Immer patches) and coalesce rapid edits within a 300ms window.

production_failures.symptom: Redo stack retains stale future branches after editing mid-history
production_failures.root_cause: Pushing a new edit to the past stack forgot to clear the future (redo) array, causing Cmd+Shift+Z to jump to an incompatible timeline.
production_failures.mitigation: Always reset future = [] whenever a new user mutation is committed while past/present advance.
